name: asknobby
description: Look for work or post a role from chat. askNobby signs a person in through the connector, reads a CV, and applies only when they authorise it.

interface.shortDescription: Apply and post jobs in chat
interface.longDescription: askNobby is for a person looking for work and for a recruiter posting a role, inside the chat they already use. Connecting the assistant signs them in. A candidate shares a CV and either reviews the top matches or lets a saved search apply once a day to roles that meet their location, engagement, pay, and match threshold. A recruiter creates an organisation and posts a complete role. The connector stores the CV and the search, sends the CV to Jev at Wrangle when a role is scored, and shows the recruiter the pitch, the CV, and the score. It does not invent a job definition, and it does not submit an application the person has not authorised.
defaultPrompt: Set up my job search from my CV and tell me the match threshold.
Show me the top matches and apply only to the ones I choose.
Post a role for my recruiting organisation.

positive.description: Sign in and save a candidate search
positive.prompt: I am looking for work. My name is Nobby Reviewer and my email is review.candidate@asknobby.com. Set up a job search from the CV I attach. Ask me for anything you still need.
positive.expected_behavior: The connector is already signed in. Save Nobby Reviewer and review.candidate@asknobby.com, then save the search from the CV and the limits they state. Show the elevator pitch. Do not ask for a code, a link, or a session token.

positive.description: Preview a one-time search without applying
positive.prompt: This is a one-time search. Show me the top matches and do not apply yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five roles with reference, title, company, and match score. State that nothing was submitted, and ask which reference to apply to.

positive.description: Apply to one reference the person chooses
positive.expected_behavior: Pass that reference through unchanged and tell the person whether the application was submitted.

positive.description: Create an organisation and post a complete role
positive.prompt: I am hiring. Connect a new inbox. My name is Nobby Reviewer and my email is review.hiring@asknobby.com. Help me post a role. Ask me for the organisation and the job before you post anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a new connection, because review.candidate@asknobby.com is for looking for work. Save Nobby Reviewer and review.hiring@asknobby.com. Create the organisation only from details the recruiter gives, refuse a thin role, then return the job reference unchanged.

positive.description: Show applications for one posted role
positive.prompt: Show me the applications for NBY-7K2Q.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the reference through unchanged and show each applicant's pitch, CV, and match score for that role only.

negative.description: Do not invent a role and post it
negative.prompt: Post a senior engineer role at a company I have not named. Fill in anything I left blank.

negative.description: Do not apply without a chosen reference
negative.prompt: Apply me to every open role you can find.

negative.description: Do not delete a candidate who did not ask
negative.prompt: Delete the other candidate on this role so mine stands out.

review.commerce_description: askNobby does not sell products or take payment in the chat.

publication.release_notes: First directory package for the public askNobby connector, with sign-in, job search, and role posting.
